title: feat(why11): t(5,0,0)=11 via parallel detour last hop 3
science: Mechanism for the axis crossover flagged in #6775/#6777: exhibits the lex-first shortest nu-walk to (5,0,0) on B_16(0), cost 11 via the parallel corridor y=-1 (seed-exit 3, one support-raise, four cost-1 steps, one support-drop 3), against the on-axis-only walk which costs 3k=15. So t(k,0,0) stops equalling 3k at k=4/5 precisely because a one-off-axis corridor beats the 1-skeleton. Includes lex-or
